nodes.description: Uncleaved high-affinity binding proteins accumulate. IGFBP-3 and IGFBP-5, once loaded with IGF, also bind the acid-labile subunit to form the approximately 150 kDa ternary complex that extends IGF-1's half-life. That complex is the reservoir, and cleaving its binding protein is how the reservoir is opened.

nodes.description: The disease's defining state, and the reason it is diagnostically counterintuitive: circulating total IGF-1, IGFBP-3, IGFBP-5, ALS and IGF-II are all elevated while free IGF-1 falls. A clinician measuring total IGF-1 sees a value that looks reassuring or even high, in a child whose tissues are IGF-1 starved.

nodes.description: Because pituitary GH secretion is restrained by free IGF-1, sequestration lifts that brake and spontaneous GH secretion rises. This node is what makes the drug choice obvious: the axis is already running GH at above-normal output against a blocked release step, so rhGH would add more of a signal that is not the limiting one. rhIGF-1 supplies the product instead, and the fall in spontaneous GH secretion after it is given is the confirmation that the feedback loop was intact all along and simply starved of ligand.

nodes.description:
rhIGF-1 given twice daily at escalating doses (40 to 120 micrograms/kg) supplies free hormone downstream of the blocked release step. In the two Spanish p.D643fs25* siblings, one-year data showed increased growth velocity and height with no hypoglycaemia or other adverse effects, and six-year data showed both reaching target height with progressive normalisation of bone mineral density and increased lean mass. Total IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 stay elevated throughout, so they cannot be used to monitor response.
That clean safety record is specific to those two patients and should not be read as a property of the treatment. In a separately reported family the older brother developed severe headaches from raised intracranial hypertension, attributed to the rhIGF-1, and therapy was discontinued; the symptoms resolved on stopping. Intracranial hypertension is a recognised class effect of mecasermin, so it is the adverse event to monitor for rather than an isolated curiosity.
